{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'

# Filter for converted customers (converted == 1)
converted_mask = sales['converted'] == 1

# Combine: only converted customers, regardless of status or QA
# The question asks for mean age of customers who converted — not necessarily completed
# So we keep all converted customers, even if refunded
filtered_data = sales[converted_mask].copy()

# Check how many converted customers there are
print('Converted customers count (all, including refunded):', len(filtered_data))

# Now compute mean age of converted customers — but exclude -1 as missing
# -1 means 'no age supplied', so we must exclude it
valid_age_mask = filtered_data['customer_age'] != -1

# Filter out -1 values
filtered_data_valid = filtered_data[valid_age_mask]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = filtered_data_valid['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f'Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age_converted:.2f}')"}
